relations.subject: Bhim Dev
relations.evidence: I very much appreciate the hard work that my immediate assistant, Prof, Bhim Dev and other colleagues... had to do in connection with the final preparation and publication of this book.

relations.subject: VISHVA BANDHU
relations.evidence: Towards the end of March, 1951, he requested the present writer that a compilation of some 700 original texts which he had made from Classical Sanskrit literature... might be included in our Institute publications.
